title: LRT-2 back to normal operations after damaged catenary wire
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The train lines of Light Rail Transit 2 (LRT-2) resumed full operations on Wednesday after a lightning struck and severed a catenary wire at its Antipolo station on Tuesday…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The train lines of Light Rail Transit 2 (LRT-2) resumed full operations on Wednesday after a lightning struck and severed a catenary wire at its Antipolo station on Tuesday afternoon, according to the Light Rail Transit Authority (LRTA).
